question: Any person in-charge of or employed in a child care institution, who subjects a child to corporal punishment shall be liable under ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** the Juvenile Justice Act.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** Juvenile Justice Act:

 
• **This act was enacted in 2000 to provide a comprehensive framework for the care, protection, and rehabilitation of children in need of care and protection.**

 
 
• The act defines corporal punishment as any punishment in which physical force is used and intended to cause some degree of pain or discomfort, however light.
 
• It prohibits the use of corporal punishment in any child care institution, including foster care, adoption, and rehabilitation centers.
 
• The act also provides for the establishment of Juvenile Justice Boards and Child Welfare Committees to deal with cases of children in conflict with the law and children in need of care and protection, respectively.
 
 
 
• Indian Advocate's Act, on the other hand, deals with the regulation of the legal profession and legal education in India. It does not have any provisions related to child care or corporal punishment.
 
• The Hindu Succession Act deals with the inheritance rights of Hindus. It is not relevant to the question.
 
• The Hindu Adoption Act deals with the adoption of children by Hindus. It does not have any provisions related to corporal punishment.
